items.exampleEn: We remember our first home with fondness.
items.exampleZh: 我們懷著喜愛回想我們的第一個家。

items.exampleEn: We were unlucky with the weather on our trip.
items.exampleZh: 我們這趟旅行碰上的天氣很不走運。

items.exampleEn: His nervousness disappeared after the first song.
items.exampleZh: 唱完第一首歌後，他的緊張就消失了。

items.exampleEn: The waiter hurriedly cleaned the table for the next customers.
items.exampleZh: 服務生匆忙地為下一批客人收拾桌子。

items.exampleEn: The little girl bravely jumped into the cold water.
items.exampleZh: 那個小女孩勇敢地跳進冷水裡。

items.exampleEn: The diligent farmer works from morning till night.
items.exampleZh: 那位勤奮的農夫從早工作到晚。
隨和的人很快就能交到朋友。

items.exampleEn: Her diligence helped her win the scholarship.
items.exampleZh: 她的勤奮幫助她贏得了獎學金。

items.audioEn: He hurriedly hid the gift when his sister walked in.
items.audioZh: 他的姊妹走進來時，他匆忙把禮物藏起來。
items.questionZh: 他為什麼匆忙藏起禮物？

items.sentenceEn: He felt a strange nervousness on his first day at work.
items.sentenceZh: 他第一天上班時感到一種奇怪的緊張。

items.sentenceEn: Our new teacher is very easygoing.

items.stemEn: Most ____ students do well on tests.
items.stemZh: 大多數用功的學生考試都考得好。

items.stemEn: Although she was afraid of heights, she ____ climbed to the top of the tower.
items.stemZh: 雖然她怕高，她還是勇敢地爬上了塔頂。

items.passageEn: Last spring, my best friend Ben entered a speech contest. He is easygoing and has a fondness for telling jokes, but speaking on stage was hard for him. He is also very diligent, so he practiced every day for a month. On the day of the contest, he was unlucky: his bus broke down, and he had to hurriedly take a taxi. Before his turn, I could see his nervousness. But he bravely walked on stage, and his speech was stunning. The judges said they could see his diligence. He won second prize!
items.passageZh: 去年春天，我最好的朋友 Ben 參加了一場演講比賽。他個性隨和，很喜歡講笑話，但在台上說話對他來說很難。他也非常勤奮，所以整整一個月每天都練習。比賽那天他很倒楣：他搭的公車拋錨了，只好匆忙地改搭計程車。輪到他之前，我看得出他很緊張。但他勇敢地走上台，演講精彩得令人驚嘆。評審說，他們看得出他的勤奮。他得了第二名！

questions.questionZh: 比賽那天 Ben 遇到什麼倒楣的事？
options: 他的白襯衫被果汁弄髒了
他把寫好的講稿忘在家裡
他前一天晚上睡不著覺
他搭的公車拋錨，只好改搭計程車
他的笑話一點也不好笑
看得出 Ben 非常勤奮

rubricZh: hurriedly 表示「匆忙地」，例如 hurriedly leave 等說法
時態配合內容（例如說過去的事用過去式等）

items.promptZh: 我的新鄰居很隨和，很少為小事煩惱。
referenceEn: My new neighbor is easygoing and rarely worries about small things.
My new neighbor is very easygoing; small things rarely bother him.
rubricZh: 用 easygoing 表示「隨和的」
鄰居用 he、she 都可以
